item.tib: sgra gcan rtag d+hA'i re mig bzhi brgya dang drug cu bskal par 'khor ba'i ngo mtshar bltas chog
item.coloph: ces sgra gcan gyi drwa ba ka 'di ltar sngon gyi dran dbang rnams kyis bkod yod pa gor ma chag kyang / 'di phyogs kyi sa ris mkhan tshor rtsad gcod 'dra byas rung / ma phyi ma rnyed pa'i blo ngan gyi lor kho bos rnam dpyod las gsar du phyung ba shu b+haM//
